hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Broodfall shared startup context: SHIP-CHECKLIST.md is the canonical delivery roadmap. On the first reply of each new Claude chat, render .claude/launch-roadmap.html with the available interactive-widget tool, then continue with the user's request. If no widget tool is available, do not block; give a concise current-priority status from SHIP-CHECKLIST.md instead. Treat SHIP-CHECKLIST.md as authoritative whenever the visual and checklist disagree, and keep them synchronized when milestones change. Codex receives the same shared context through the repository-root AGENTS.md.
